ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the northern United States, schools are sometimes closed during winter due to severe snowstorms. At the end of the school year, schools have to make up for the days missed. The following graph shows the frequency distribution of the number of days missed due to snowstorms per year using data collected from the past 75 years. Which of the following should be used to describe the center of this distribution?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: Median, because the distribution is skewed
